name: base_utils
description: Shared utility module that manages /etc/motd and configurable utility packages, and provides reusable Puppet functions, defined types, custom facts, typed values, data, and Bolt task material.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Python application stack profile that prepares the Python runtime, application checkout, PostgreSQL connection configuration, systemd service, monitoring/logging, and deployment-related files.

name: profile_haproxy
description: HAProxy load-balancer profile that installs HAProxy, renders primary and backend configuration, manages the service and firewall behavior, and installs custom error pages.

name: profile_postgresql
description: PostgreSQL installation profile that manages the repository, packages, and service in a defined repository-to-installation-to-service sequence.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Redis profile that installs and configures Redis with password protection, AOF/RDB persistence, memory limits, and an attempted PuppetDB-based node discovery mechanism.
